about.title: About me
about.p1: Hello! I am Gonçalo Martins de Lima, a 2nd-year student in Cybersecurity, Networks, and Computer Systems at the School of Technology and Management (ESTG) of the Polytechnic of Porto (P.PORTO).
about.p2: My journey in computer science began at Escola Secundária de Felgueiras in the IT Management & Programming course (GPSI), where I developed my passion for programming logic, system architecture, and web development.
about.p3: Currently, I focus on combining modern Web Development (React, JavaScript, C#, Node.js) with Cybersecurity & Computer Networks. My next goal is to enroll in a B.Sc. in Information Security in Computer Networks and join dynamic teams where I can continue to grow and make a positive impact.
about.stat3Desc: B.Sc. in Information Security & Networks & Junior Dev / Internship
